hero.heading: Fare Position Tool
hero.body: Enter a route to see where your fares sit against everything else selling on it. Powered by live market data from AeroExpert's fare intelligence platform.

steps.title: Enter your route
steps.description: Type the three-letter IATA codes for origin and destination — for example DXB and LHR.

steps.title: Select a cabin
steps.description: Optionally filter by cabin class: Economy, Premium Economy, Business or First.

steps.title: Compare instantly
steps.description: See your fare plotted against the market range, with a clear verdict on your competitive position.
